as_told.title: Bob Lazar briefed on Project Looking Glass

plain: A man named Bob Lazar, who says he worked at a secret site in Nevada, was briefed on Project Looking Glass, a programme Michels names but does not describe. Michels says this himself twice in one episode, citing Lazar and a man named Timothy Taylor, and once places it in Nevada in 1988 and 1989. If true, it would tie Lazar to a second secret programme beyond the one he is known for.
